name: TideGS
definition: A fully out-of-core optimization method that pushes the frontier to over one billion primitives by streaming Gaussians from disk in a view-dependent order, training on a single machine with only a fraction of the data in GPU memory.
summary: TideGS is a single-GPU, out-of-core training framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that enables over one billion primitives by caching only active subsets in VRAM.
